title: Extension by zero along an open immersion and its defining properties
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for an open immersion j : U -> X the adjunction mappings between F and j^{-1}j_*F and between F and j^{-1}j_!F are isomorphisms, and that j_!F is the unique abelian sheaf on X_etale restricting to F on U with vanishing stalks at geometric points outside U (statement lines 11467-11476). The proof establishes the isomorphisms from the description of the sections of extension by zero (proof lines 11478-11484) and then uses the stalk behaviour to obtain uniqueness (proof lines 11484-11490). The non-formal content is the identification of extension by zero by its restriction and vanishing stalks. The claim is H2: one identification plus one uniqueness argument.
